steps.text: Sign in to Disney+ in a web browser.
Open the profile menu and choose Account.

steps.note: The page differs by country and plan. If you do not see this option, a partner may bill you.
Check the end date the service shows. Payments stop on the date you set.

steps.text: If a partner bills you, cancel with that partner.
steps.note: If you pay through Apple, Google or a mobile carrier, cancel there. See the Apple App Store or Google Play guide.
